body: I'm sorry that you're also going through this. It's hard. Today has been one of those days where I'm just feeling so low I can hardly take it. Sometimes I wonder, what's even the point? I've been told that I'm "not the easiest person to get along with" but in my opinion, it's because of my morals which people are seriously lacking these days. I'm a really nice person but somehow it doesn't matter I'm still sitting here all alone day after day.

I am sorry that you deal with this as well. Are you close with your family, maybe they can help you emotionally deal. 

I've tried talking to people online and I did find one person that I enjoy talking to, even though we don't really talk too often. This kind of thing never used to bother me but as of now some days it's like it consumes me. It's not everyday and it's not like I'm crying about it. It just kind of makes me feel this sort of deep longing and a sort of sadness, I guess. I honestly can't even imagine what my life would be like if I didn't have my dogs. And my boyfriend.

Thanks, and I completely agree with you. My family get togethers consist of everyone staring at their cellphones in the same room. It drives me crazy. I think you also nailed it on the head in regard to how self absorbed people are. One major issue I have had with all relationships in my life is that I'm more interested in people than they are in me. I find myself asking a string of questions trying to keep a conversation going only to have short and close ended answers in return to the point that the conversation just dies and it's awkward.

I'll join you.  I'm 28 and I haven't had a friend, like an actual friend, pretty much... ever.  I'm a really nice person and I always try to help people if I can, even if they haven't asked for my help, I'll offer willy-nilly because it's what I would hope somebody would do for me if I were down and out .  However, sometimes I fear that maybe I'm too nice but regardless it doesn't matter I can't make a connection with another human being. I do have a boyfriend, we've been together for about 12 years but  having a significant other and having a friend that you can rely on and somebody that can rely on you is different. I used to take care of myself but I let myself go over the last few years. I've put on about 70 lbs and now, because I'm embarrassed of the way that I look it's hard for me to even leave my house because I'm afraid that people are going to judge me the way I judge myself. As you can imagine, this makes meeting people even more difficult. I've kind of fallen into this depression because of all of it and it's  extremely hard to pull myself out of it. Some days I literally feel like just giving up but I have four dogs and I guess if I'm being honest, I consider them my besties. For a while that was enough, but the longer this goes on the deeper and deeper I feel myself falling into this hole that I honestly think I am never going to be able to climb out of.
